mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals a strengthening labor market that improves corporate earnings prospects, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 9.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9.0% over the past 5 days signals rapid labor market improvement, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 9.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 1.0% MoM), economic growth accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 1.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding economic activity, typically leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.
